task.title: M10 RED tests
task.description: Write meaningful RED regression tests for actual tool-call/round budget stop using local provider stub, stress JSON resolver/report and optional containment port; determine all scripts typecheck failures and propose bounded testable corrections. Read existing agent tests and benchmark entrypoints. Do not run external providers or import executable benchmark top levels blindly. Do not implement source. Return test_case_specs and precise observed failures.

acceptance_criteria: AC3: M10: offline stub proves the actual configured round/call budget stops execution with a truthful terminal reason; maxToolCalls is never silently ignored or represented by maxRounds.
AC4: M10: stress JSON creation uses an existing resolver and writes a report in the offline fixture; optional containment port is handled with no unsafe default.
AC5: M10: a scripts TypeScript check covers the benchmark/stress scripts and fails on an injected type error; root and scripts checks pass without external model calls.
constraints: Use local tests-creator skill and testing context; graph/wiki before deeper reads, keryx ctx rg only for code search.
Only write lane-owned tests and artifacts. No implementation code. No commits/staging/checkout/push; parent owns git.
Do not edit flow.json or frozen acceptance criteria; parent owns all flow transitions.
commit_test_stubs=false: shared feature branch with simultaneous workers.
Stats disabled; no external model calls, no private dataset copying.
Do not modify unrelated files. Coordinate shared test file ownership before edits.
Return STATUS first and validate subagent-result; persist RED command/output and test_case_specs in artifacts.
